name: @trymirage.app/mcp

tools.name: mirage_status
tools.description: Connection, sign-in, User Scripts availability, credits when cheap, and extension version.

profile.description: Chrome profile to use: profile id, label, Chrome profile name, or email. Optional when only one profile is connected or a default is saved (mirage_use_profile).

tools.name: mirage_list_tabs
tools.description: http(s) tabs: tabId, origin, title, active. Origin only, not path/query. Incognito tabs are omitted.

profile.description: Chrome profile to use: profile id, label, Chrome profile name, or email. Optional when only one profile is connected or a default is saved (mirage_use_profile).

tools.name: mirage_get_active_tab
tools.description: Active http(s) tab plus enabled adaptation ids/titles on that origin. Ignores tabId. Incognito is omitted.

profile.description: Chrome profile to use: profile id, label, Chrome profile name, or email. Optional when only one profile is connected or a default is saved (mirage_use_profile).

tools.name: mirage_list_adaptations
tools.description: Installed userscript and Gallery looks: id, title (untrusted), summary, siteOrigin, enabled, source. Capped.

profile.description: Chrome profile to use: profile id, label, Chrome profile name, or email. Optional when only one profile is connected or a default is saved (mirage_use_profile).

tools.name: mirage_get_adaptation
tools.description: One adaptation summary and executionSummary. Source is never returned in this step.

profile.description: Chrome profile to use: profile id, label, Chrome profile name, or email. Optional when only one profile is connected or a default is saved (mirage_use_profile).

tools.name: mirage_list_library
tools.description: Curated catalog metadata (no script source). Optional host filter.

profile.description: Chrome profile to use: profile id, label, Chrome profile name, or email. Optional when only one profile is connected or a default is saved (mirage_use_profile).

tools.name: mirage_list_chats
tools.description: Local chat index: id, title preview, host, and client (the coding tool that started it, when one did). No full transcript.

profile.description: Chrome profile to use: profile id, label, Chrome profile name, or email. Optional when only one profile is connected or a default is saved (mirage_use_profile).

tools.name: mirage_page_sketch
tools.description: Bounded untrusted landmarks/samples for an http(s) tab. Blocked on banking/checkout.

profile.description: Chrome profile to use: profile id, label, Chrome profile name, or email. Optional when only one profile is connected or a default is saved (mirage_use_profile).

tools.name: mirage_screenshot
tools.description: JPEG of a tab: the session tab (from mirage_open_tab) or tabId; without either, the active tab. A Mirage-window tab is switched to inside its own window (no focus change). The user's own tabs must already be active. If the window is hidden and capture fails, use mirage_page_sketch. Saved to a 0700 user dir (keep 50 / 7 days). Returns file path, not inline pixels. 2/sec.

profile.description: Chrome profile to use: profile id, label, Chrome profile name, or email. Optional when only one profile is connected or a default is saved (mirage_use_profile).

tools.name: mirage_ask
tools.description: Ask about the session tab (or tabId / active tab) via hosted /run (mode ask). Does not Apply. Blocked on sensitive sites. 401/402 returned as tool errors.

profile.description: Chrome profile to use: profile id, label, Chrome profile name, or email. Optional when only one profile is connected or a default is saved (mirage_use_profile).

tools.name: mirage_create_draft
tools.description: Draft a look via hosted /run (mode agent) from the session tab (or tabId / active tab): title, page sketch, and a capped JPEG. Stores a pending draft only — never registers userScripts. Apply with mirage_apply. One site in one coding session is one Mirage chat and one look: by default a new draft REVISES the live look in that chat (follow-ups like "also hide X" or "make it lighter" stay one look). Pass look "new" only when the user asked for something unrelated or for a separate look; that starts a new chat and a new look.

look.description: revise (default): change the live look in this chat. new: start a separate look in a new chat.

profile.description: Chrome profile to use: profile id, label, Chrome profile name, or email. Optional when only one profile is connected or a default is saved (mirage_use_profile).

tools.name: mirage_apply
tools.description: Apply a pending draftHash, catalog slug, or installed adaptationId on the session tab (or tabId / active tab), through the same User Scripts Apply as the side panel. Follows Mirage's approval mode (Auto applies; Manual refuses). Returns verification { status, matched, stillVisible } from Mirage's DOM check (works in the background; matched 0 means the look touched nothing — refine the draft; status inconclusive is not a failure) and before/after screenshot files when capture is possible. Returns lookId and version: each Apply in the same chat adds a version to the same look, and it appears in Gallery once.

profile.description: Chrome profile to use: profile id, label, Chrome profile name, or email. Optional when only one profile is connected or a default is saved (mirage_use_profile).

tools.name: mirage_manage
tools.description: action: undo (go back one version of the look in this chat; if it has only one version, turn it off), log (local write log), kill (stop further writes immediately, then disconnect), disable (turn Allow coding tools off after the reply).

profile.description: Chrome profile to use: profile id, label, Chrome profile name, or email. Optional when only one profile is connected or a default is saved (mirage_use_profile).

tools.name: mirage_open_tab
tools.description: Open an http(s) page in the background Mirage window of the chosen profile: no focus change, tab muted, grouped under "Mirage". Waits for load. Becomes the session tab that later tools use. Returns tabId, origin, title (untrusted).

profile.description: Chrome profile to use: profile id, label, Chrome profile name, or email. Optional when only one profile is connected or a default is saved (mirage_use_profile).

tools.name: mirage_navigate
tools.description: Load a new http(s) URL in a tab opened by mirage_open_tab. The user's own tabs cannot be navigated.

profile.description: Chrome profile to use: profile id, label, Chrome profile name, or email. Optional when only one profile is connected or a default is saved (mirage_use_profile).

tools.name: mirage_focus_tab
tools.description: Bring a tab and its window to the front. The only tool that changes focus; use only when the user asks to see it.

profile.description: Chrome profile to use: profile id, label, Chrome profile name, or email. Optional when only one profile is connected or a default is saved (mirage_use_profile).

tools.name: mirage_close_session
tools.description: Close the background Mirage window and its tabs. Applied looks stay installed.

profile.description: Chrome profile to use: profile id, label, Chrome profile name, or email. Optional when only one profile is connected or a default is saved (mirage_use_profile).

tools.name: mirage_list_profiles
tools.description: Chrome profiles with Mirage: connected ones and installed-but-closed ones. Shows label, Chrome profile name, masked email, and which is the saved default. Use the profile value with other tools or mirage_use_profile.

tools.name: mirage_use_profile
tools.description: Save the default Chrome profile for every coding tool on this computer. Accepts a profile id, label, Chrome profile name, or email from mirage_list_profiles.

instructions: Operate Mirage in Chrome without leaving the coding tool. Start with mirage_open_tab(url): it opens the page in a background Mirage window (no focus change, muted) and later tools target that tab automatically. Then mirage_page_sketch / mirage_create_draft / mirage_apply; verify with mirage_screenshot or mirage_page_sketch; mirage_manage undo/kill. Work in one Mirage chat per site: later requests on the same site revise the same look; pass look "new" to mirage_create_draft only for an unrelated or separate look. With several Chrome profiles, call mirage_list_profiles. Setup: `mirage-mcp install`, then in Mirage Settings turn on Allow coding tools and sign in.
